Conditioning on zero or positive Poisson counts proves the two-Gaussian mixture, covariance and conditional variance; Wick contractions give the strictly positive connected fourth cumulant. Exact derivative proves the unique maximizer, time rescaling proves strict peak monotonicity and limits, and Gaussian cross-entropy matching proves the positive KL mutual-information gap. All critical cases use λ,D,r,t>0. The supplied script verifies identities and numerical samples; the analytic proof covers the continuum.
